Fees note (manual 2026-09-20, not overwritten) - proposed text: "MA DCR publishes this campground's rate by name: $24 a night for a Massachusetts resident, $70 for everyone else. Electric is $6 a night on top. The $24 resident rate is the highest DCR charges, and the $70 out-of-state rate is flat across all four coastal campgrounds. ReserveAmerica's fee text breaks the resident rate into $22 plus a $2-a-day Horseneck Beach Trust surcharge charged on all reservations. Out-of-state is the charge to plan for - it is the camping rate, not a gate fee, so no pass avoids it. Add $4.50 per reservation (not per night); no entrance fee for campers." Source: https://www.mass.gov/info-details/camping-fees ('Horseneck Beach State Reservation $24 $70 ... $6') + https://massdcrcamping.reserveamerica.com/camping/horseneck-beach-state-reservation/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MA&parkId=32609 ('$22 for MA resident / $70 for non-resident plus $6 electric surcharge on sites 1-68, and a $2 Horseneck Beach Trust surcharge (per day) for all reservations') + https://www.mass.gov/locations/horseneck-beach-state-reservation ('$24 per night / standard non electric sites and $30 per night/ electric hookups. $70 per night for non-residents'), read 2026-10-28.
